6471783.name: Chabad of San Tan Valley
6471783.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024 ('Chabad Responds to Tragedy by Expanding Global Outreach: 100 New Centers To Be Established'): Keren Hashluchim seed funding 'for one hundred new Chabad centers in underserved areas'; among 'The Fifty New Shluchim': 'Rabbi Mendel and Rivky Wolowik at Chabad of San Tan Valley, AZ' (a new community Chabad House). Its chabad.org listing went up 17 July 2024; its own site gives no year.
